question: Under parity, over every dropped-junction choice of the completed system, which choices grow the eddies, and does the largest-point (fewest places) rule reproduce the cheapest growth?

public_inputs.run: scripts/longrun.py launch job.py; python3 -B merge.py <out dir> <results.json>
public_inputs.reused: JOIN-GROWTH joinlib; LOOP-CATALOGUE job_iso.classify, eddy.py, catalogue.json; CLUSTER-ALL posthoc_dimension.json; TOUCH-CENSUS arrlib

forbidden_inputs: Changing a start, the class rule or a prediction after reading any frozen growth
cheapest_meaningful_control: the original choice on every start

predictions.D1: only the original choice grows the eddies
predictions.D2: original is the unique largest point on the eddies (forced; a check)
predictions.D3: the largest-point rule changes the class somewhere among the samples where it is not the original

decision_rules.each: held iff no exception (D3: iff at least one)

stop_rule: One run; read-out; referee hand-off; report.
disclosed_exploration: pilot (three rings of five, every choice)
